---
name: autopilot
description: Analyze the codebase, open GitHub issues, and ROADMAP.md to implement the best next feature or improvement end to end.
---

1. Analyze the codebase, recent commits, `ROADMAP.md`, and open GitHub issues (`gh issue list`) to identify the highest-priority improvement or feature to implement.
2. Select an actionable task that aligns with active GitHub issues and unreleased roadmap milestones.
3. Implement the feature or improvement with focused tests, keeping changes aligned with existing Flutter/Dart and Firebase patterns.
4. Reference the associated GitHub issue(s) in commits (e.g., `feat: ... (#<num>)` or `closes #<num>`).
5. Run lint and test validations to ensure zero regressions.
6. Update documentation, `ROADMAP.md`, and related GitHub issues accordingly.
7. Suggest concrete next steps tied to the roadmap and remaining open GitHub issues.
